title: System memories are invariants, not ledgers
content: System memories must state current system invariants and operational runbooks, not serve as release ledgers or artifact inventories. Do not mirror atom names, versions, statuses, costs, eval fixtures, supersession history, or implementation chronology in SMs. Mention atoms only as contextual signposts to `atom_search` / `atom_describe` when an atom should replace a manual tool sequence; put deeper atom mechanics in `sm-atoms`, and keep shipped artifact inventory in manifests/artifact tooling.
